-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='G0483'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key),
firstsub AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims c GROUP BY c.claim_key, c.payer_key)
SELECT p.payer_class, COUNT(*) AS paid_claims,
 ROUND(MEDIAN(r.payment_date - f.first_sub), 1) AS median_days_to_pay,
 ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(r.payment_date - f.first_sub, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days_to_pay
FROM prim p JOIN firstsub f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0
GROUP BY p.payer_class ORDER BY p.payer_class

SELECT a.carc_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_key || '|' || a.payer_key) AS denied_claims
FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = a.claim_key AND r.payer_key = a.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY a.carc_code ORDER BY denied_claims DESC, a.carc_code LIMIT 5

WITH pairs AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, COUNT(*) AS n_events,
  BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS cur_ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS pairs_remitted, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND cur_ok) AS first_pass_resolved,
 ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND cur_ok) / COUNT(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct
FROM pairs GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH pairs AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS n_trace,
  BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AS has_rev, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) AS has_cur,
  COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS cur_paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS multi_trace_pairs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_rev) AS with_reversal,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_cur) AS no_current, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM pairs WHERE n_trace >= 2 GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT COUNT(*) AS denied_lines_on_non_denied_claims FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

WITH prim AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.adjustment_amount), 0) AS primary_deductible FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN prim USING (claim_key, payer_key)
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'

WITH c AS (SELECT service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'),
by_npi AS (SELECT service_month, referring_npi, COUNT(*) AS n,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, referring_npi) AS rk FROM c GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi)
SELECT strftime(service_month, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(n) AS total_claims, SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE rk <= 5) AS top5_claims,
 ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE rk <= 5) / SUM(n), 1) AS top5_share_pct
FROM by_npi GROUP BY service_month ORDER BY service_month

-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='87798'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH adj AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication),
cpt AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM (SELECT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines UNION ALL SELECT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.remit_lines))
SELECT cpt.procedure_code, COUNT(*) AS adjudications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE adj.is_denied) AS denied,
 ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE adj.is_denied) / COUNT(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct
FROM adj JOIN cpt USING (claim_key) GROUP BY cpt.procedure_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY denial_rate_pct DESC, cpt.procedure_code

WITH latest AS (SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
prim AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'),
x AS (SELECT l.claim_key, CASE WHEN l.line_count >= 3 THEN '3+' ELSE CAST(l.line_count AS VARCHAR) END AS bucket, l.charge_amount, r.is_denied
  FROM latest l JOIN prim p USING (claim_key) JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_claims,
 ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) / COUNT(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
 COALESCE(SUM(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied), 0) AS denied_billed_charge
FROM x GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

WITH fb AS (SELECT payer_key, reference_id, provider_adjustment_amount AS amt, payment_date FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB')
SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carried_forward_date, ROUND(-c.amt, 2) AS amount_carried_forward,
 MIN(o.payment_date) AS offset_payment_date, MIN(o.payment_date) - c.payment_date AS days_between
FROM fb c LEFT JOIN fb o ON o.payer_key = c.payer_key AND o.reference_id = c.reference_id AND o.amt = -c.amt AND o.payment_date > c.payment_date
WHERE c.amt < 0 GROUP BY c.reference_id, c.payment_date, c.amt ORDER BY carried_forward_date, c.reference_id

WITH cur AS (SELECT payer_class, payment_month, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication),
m AS (SELECT payer_class,
  SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM cur WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01'), 0) * 100 AS jul,
  SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM cur WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01'), 0) * 100 AS aug
  FROM cur WHERE payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01') GROUP BY payer_class)
SELECT payer_class, ROUND(jul, 1) AS jul_share_pct, ROUND(aug, 1) AS aug_share_pct, ROUND(aug - jul, 1) AS change_pp FROM m ORDER BY payer_class

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS rep_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' AND payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY ALL),
orig AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS orig_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '1' GROUP BY ALL),
x AS (SELECT rep.*, orig.orig_date, r.payment_date, r.paid_amount FROM rep LEFT JOIN orig USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = rep.claim_key AND r.payer_key = rep.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.payment_date >= rep.rep_date)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(rep_date - orig_date), 2) AS avg_days_orig_to_replacement,
 COUNT(payment_date) AS paid_after_replacement, ROUND(AVG(payment_date - orig_date), 2) AS avg_days_orig_to_payment,
 COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS total_paid FROM x

WITH v AS (
  SELECT claim_key, MIN(d) AS void_date FROM (
    SELECT claim_key, submission_date AS d FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8'
    UNION ALL SELECT claim_key, payment_date AS d FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE frequency_code = '8') GROUP BY claim_key),
x AS (SELECT v.claim_key,
  BOOL_OR(r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date) AS paid_before,
  BOOL_OR(r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date) AS reversed_after,
  SUM(r.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) AS cur_paid
  FROM v LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = v.claim_key GROUP BY v.claim_key)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS voided_claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_before) AS paid_before_void,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reversed_after) AS reversed_after_void, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM x
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount = 0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, MIN(submission_date) AS rep_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key),
resp AS (SELECT rep.claim_key, rep.payer_class, MIN(r.payment_date) - rep.rep_date AS days FROM rep JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = rep.claim_key AND r.payer_key = rep.payer_key AND r.payment_date >= rep.rep_date GROUP BY rep.claim_key, rep.payer_key, rep.payer_class, rep.rep_date)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(days), 1) AS avg_days, MIN(days) AS min_days, MAX(days) AS max_days
FROM resp GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reversed_no_current FROM (SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY ALL
HAVING BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AND NOT BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication))

-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='80307'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '80307') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key),
firstsub AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims c GROUP BY c.claim_key, c.payer_key),
cohort AS (SELECT p.claim_key, p.payer_key, p.payer_class, f.first_sub FROM prim p JOIN firstsub f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  WHERE f.first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'),
fr AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_class, MIN(r.payment_date) - c.first_sub AS d FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = c.claim_key AND r.payer_key = c.payer_key GROUP BY c.claim_key, c.payer_key, c.payer_class, c.first_sub)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS cohort_claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d <= 14) AS remitted_within_14d,
 ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d <= 14) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_within_14d FROM fr GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='G0482'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0482') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS rep_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key),
d AS (SELECT rep.* FROM rep WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = rep.claim_key AND r.payer_key = rep.payer_key
  AND r.claim_status_code = '4' AND r.payment_date < rep.rep_date)),
x AS (SELECT d.claim_key,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = d.claim_key AND r.payer_key = d.payer_key AND r.payment_date >= d.rep_date) AS remit_since,
  (SELECT BOOL_OR(is_denied) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = d.claim_key AND r.payer_key = d.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) AS cur_denied,
  (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = d.claim_key AND r.payer_key = d.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) AS cur_paid FROM d)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT remit_since THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cur_denied IS FALSE THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END AS outcome,
 COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM x GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key,
  BOOL_OR(adjudication_state = 'superseded' AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied) AS had_sup_denial,
  BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS cur_ok, SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) AS cur_paid
  FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS overturned_pairs, COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid), 0) AS current_paid FROM p WHERE had_sup_denial AND cur_ok

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key),
firstsub AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims c GROUP BY c.claim_key, c.payer_key),
latest AS (SELECT claim_key, charge_amount, frequency_code FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
open AS (SELECT p.claim_key, DATE '2026-08-14' - f.first_sub AS age, l.charge_amount FROM prim p JOIN firstsub f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  JOIN latest l ON l.claim_key = p.claim_key
  WHERE l.frequency_code <> '8' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication))
SELECT CASE WHEN age <= 14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age <= 29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS claims, SUM(charge_amount) AS billed_charge
FROM open GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(age)

WITH f AS (SELECT claim_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims GROUP BY claim_key)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_remitted FROM f WHERE first_sub >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND first_sub < DATE '2026-08-01'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = f.claim_key)

WITH l AS (SELECT payer_key, payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount AS allowed FROM sem.remit_lines
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied AND NOT is_reversal AND units_paid = 1 AND line_allowed_amount > 0),
freq AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, allowed, COUNT(*) AS n FROM l GROUP BY ALL),
typ AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, allowed AS typical FROM freq QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, allowed DESC) = 1)
SELECT l.payer_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical) AS underpaid_lines,
 ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.typical - l.allowed) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM l JOIN typ t USING (payer_key, procedure_code) GROUP BY l.payer_name ORDER BY shortfall DESC, l.payer_name

-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='G0480'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0480') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH m AS (SELECT payer_class, payment_month, COUNT(*) AS adj, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied,
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) / COUNT(*) AS rate FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS month, adj AS current_adjudications, denied, ROUND(rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
 ROUND(rate - LAG(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month), 2) AS change_pp FROM m ORDER BY payer_class, month

-- spec: metric=paid share; population=835 service lines on current adjudications; filter procedure_code (as submitted)='81479'; grain=one row
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '81479') / SUM(line_paid_amount), 6) AS share_of_line_paid
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'),
ref AS (SELECT claim_key, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
x AS (SELECT ref.referring_npi, r.is_denied FROM prim JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = prim.claim_key AND r.payer_key = prim.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
  JOIN ref ON ref.claim_key = prim.claim_key)
SELECT referring_npi, COUNT(*) AS claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) / COUNT(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct
FROM x GROUP BY referring_npi HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY denial_rate_pct DESC, referring_npi LIMIT 5
